Why Everguard

The standard your cases demand

Every investigation we conduct is designed to withstand scrutiny — from a claims assessor, a legal counsel, or a judge. We operate to the same standard regardless of case size or client.

Enquire Now

Licensed across Australia

Every investigator holds a current Australian private investigator licence for the state they operate in. No exceptions.

Court-ready documentation

Reports are prepared to the evidentiary standard required by Australian courts, tribunals, and claims processes from day one.

Strict confidentiality

Client identity, case details, and investigation methodology are protected by contract and professional obligation — always.

Fast, clearly scoped delivery

Investigation timelines are scoped at instruction and communicated clearly upfront. Urgent matters are prioritised where operationally possible.

National capability

Operating across all Australian states and territories. Metropolitan, regional, and remote locations covered through our investigator network.

No lock-in

Case-by-case engagement with no minimum volumes, no retainer requirements, and no lock-in periods. Use us when you need us.
